description:
Activate Tezzeret the Seeker's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret the Seeker's ability, targeting Lithoform Engine and Gilded Lotus.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret the Seeker's ability, untapping Gilded Lotus and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
